project_type: Full-stack TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo (server: Node+Express+better-sqlite3; web: React+Vite). AI-assisted Subscription Revenue Recovery + Trust/Access Decision Engine.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts delegate to server/web. Server dev runs TS directly via a register hook (server/src/register-ts.mjs, ts-resolve-hook.mjs) with cwd=server/.
test_framework: Vitest (server workspace only). 10 test files under server/test/. Baseline is 133/133 passing. api.e2e.test.ts uses supertest against an in-memory sqlite DB and drives the real engine over all 7 seeded scenarios. The stderr line about 'payment.definitely_not_real' is an INTENTIONAL negative-path test, not a failure.
build_command: npm run build (root) -> server tsc, then web tsc -b && vite build. Must stay zero-error.
test_command: npm test (root) -> runs server Vitest. Must stay 133/133 (plus new tests) green.
verification_instructions: 1) npm test (all green). 2) npm run build (zero errors both workspaces). 3) npm run seed (prints 7 OK lines + 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations).'). 4) npm run dev:server backgrounded, curl http://localhost:4000/api/health, then stop. 5) web build via npm run build:web.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. server/dist and web/dist are gitignored build output. SQLite DBs under data/ and server/data/ are gitignored.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Network mode OPEN_INTERNET.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. The repo-root .env contains a PLACEHOLDER OpenRouter key (OPENROUTER_API_KEY=PASTE_YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_HERE), so createLlmAdapter currently treats OpenRouter as ENABLED and any real call returns HTTP 401. Tests must NOT hit the network: mock fetch. Do NOT commit .env or any *.db files (gitignored; keep it that way). Never print/commit/hardcode the API key anywhere (logs, README, frontend, .env.example).
contribution_requirements: Commit locally on branch main only. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles that). Group into clean, well-described commits. Do NOT change core engine/financial/risk/decision logic or thresholds. Do NOT convert Razorpay to live. Preserve human blacklist review boundary. Preserve all 7 scenario intended outcomes.
key_patterns: Adapters behind interfaces (LlmAdapter, PaymentAdapter). config.ts loads dotenv via bare 'import "dotenv/config"' (resolves .env from process.cwd()). DeterministicExplainer is the LLM fallback; OpenRouterAdapter.complete() currently swallows all failures and returns undefined so callers do 'text ?? fallbackSync()'. app.ts /explain reports source: llmAdapter.kind unconditionally (dishonest when fallback used). /api/health returns {status, paymentMode, llm}. web/src/api/types.ts mirrors backend JSON shapes exactly and must be updated when response fields change. React pages: Dashboard.tsx, CustomerDetail.tsx, CustomerList.tsx. Shared styles in web/src/styles.css.
directory_structure: server/src/{config.ts, adapters/{openrouter.ts,razorpay.ts}, api/{app.ts,server.ts}, db/, domain/, engine/, seed/}. server/test/*.test.ts (10 files). web/src/{api/{client.ts,types.ts}, components/, pages/, lib/, App.tsx, styles.css}. Root .env (canonical, gitignored, placeholder key), .env.example, README.md.
